systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Local Communities and Urban Planning, through the National Addressing Committee, with the Algerian Space Agency
systems.tiers: municipalities, through provincial and municipal technical cells; an experimental phase in Oran province (over 311,000 addresses) and a first phase of 664 million dinars across four pilot provinces including Ouargla

note: Workshops in Ouargla, June 2025, on municipal addressing plans and digitised address databases. An application the municipalities contribute to; the article states nothing about a data connection at municipal offices or about staff working online in it.
